fields.body_md:
## About this programme

Thinking of an MSc Data Science at Edinburgh? Here is what it costs, who can get in and the 2027 deadlines.

The Data Science MSc is a one-year, full-time programme in the School of Informatics, in central Edinburgh. It is taught in English and starts in September 2027. You learn how to find patterns in very large data sets. It draws on machine learning, algorithms and databases, and work on text, images, sensor data and speech.

**The most important fact for you:** you need a 2:1 in a quantitative subject, maths up to probability and statistics, and some programming.

You take two taught semesters from September to May, then write a dissertation over the summer. You stay in Edinburgh until you submit, usually in mid-August.

Edinburgh ranks 22nd in the world and 5th in the UK for Computer Science (QS by Subject 2026).

For the wider university, see our [University of Edinburgh page](/study-abroad/universities/university-of-edinburgh).

## Can you get in?

**Degree.** You need a UK 2:1 honours degree, or the international equivalent, in informatics, AI, cognitive science, computer science, econometrics, electrical engineering, linguistics, mathematics, philosophy, physics, psychology or another quantitative discipline. A 2:1 is a UK honours grade.

**Programming and maths.** You need programming experience equal to an introductory course. You also need about 60 SCQF or 30 ECTS credits of maths: calculus, linear algebra, discrete maths, and probability and statistics.

**Indian marks.** Edinburgh's [India page](https://study.ed.ac.uk/programmes/regions/india) sets the 2:1 equivalent at **60%**, or **8.0** on a 10-point CGPA scale. If your university is on Edinburgh's Indian Universities List, it is **55%** or **7.0**. Entry is competitive, so aim above the minimum.

**GRE.** The course page does not mention GRE. GRE is a US-style graduate admissions test.

**English.** IELTS is an English language test. You need **IELTS Academic 7.0** overall, with at least **6.5** in three parts and **6.0** in the fourth. TOEFL iBT taken from 21 January 2026 needs **5.0** overall, with at least **4.5** in three parts and **4.0** in the fourth. IELTS One Skill Retake is not accepted.

**ATAS.** ATAS (Academic Technology Approval Scheme) is a UK security clearance that some science and technology courses need before you get a visa. Edinburgh's course page does not say whether this course needs it. Ask the admissions team when you get your offer. If it is needed, an ATAS application takes at least **30 working days**.

## What it costs

Tuition for international students is **£47,680** a year for 2027/8. The programme is one year full-time.

Edinburgh is outside London, so the outside-London visa rule applies. This is the worked first-year total.

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Tuition for international students, 2027/8 | £47,680 |
| Living money you must show for your visa: £1,203 × 9 months | £10,827 |
| Student visa application fee, from outside the UK | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge for a visa of just over a year | £1,164 |
| **Total** | **£60,229** |

The sum is £47,680 + £10,827 + £558 + £1,164 = £60,229. With the India Merit Scholarship, it falls to **£55,229**. Travel and housing are not included.

**Living money is money you show, not a fee.** The visa rule for courses outside London rises from **£1,171** to **£1,203** a month for visa applications made on or after **30 November 2026**. A September 2027 student applies in 2027, so plan on **£1,203** for each month of your course, up to **9 months** (£10,827). You must hold this money for **28 days** in a row, and the 28-day period must end within **31 days** of the date you apply. You do not pay it to the university.

**Health surcharge.** The Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS) is a charge for using the NHS while you are in the UK. It is set by the length of your visa, not your course. For a course of 12 months or longer, the visa adds up to **1 month** before and **4 months** after the course. That makes a visa of more than a year but under 18 months. You then pay the yearly **£776** plus half of it, **£388**, so **£1,164**.

**Deposit.** If you get an offer, you pay a **£1,500** deposit to secure your place. It counts towards your tuition. You need a CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) for your visa. This is the electronic letter your university issues.

**Application fee.** There is no fee to apply.

**Living costs.** Edinburgh estimates living costs at **£18,504** a year (**£1,542** a month) for 2026-2027. That is higher than the visa amount above, so plan for it.

For the visa steps, read the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To plan the whole budget, use the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Funding

**India Merit Scholarship:** **£5,000** off tuition for the first year, for on-campus master's students in 2027/2028. There is no separate application. It goes to every eligible applicant who accepts an unconditional offer. You must be domiciled in India, pay international fees and be fully or partly self-funded.

You also need high marks from an Indian university: **80%**, or **9.0** on a 10-point CGPA scale. If your university is on Edinburgh's list, it is **70%** or **8.0**. Read the [India Merit Scholarship page](https://registryservices.ed.ac.uk/student-funding/postgraduate/international/region/asia/india-merit-scholarship) for the full rules.

## Deadlines and intakes

Edinburgh uses selection rounds. The table prints no year, but the page is for September 2027 entry.

| Round | Apply by | Decision by | Where to apply |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 31 March 2027 | 31 May 2027 | University online application |
| 2 | 31 May 2027 | 31 July 2027 | University online application |

Most decisions come within eight weeks of a deadline. Applications may close earlier if demand is high. Submit all supporting documents by the application deadline. If you need a visa, apply as early as you can.

## How to apply

1. **Check the entry rules.** You need a 2:1 or equivalent in a quantitative subject, an introductory programming course and enough maths.
2. **Apply online.** Choose the full-time MSc with a September 2027 start. Start from the [programme page](https://study.ed.ac.uk/programmes/postgraduate-taught/902-data-science).
3. **Prepare your documents.** Edinburgh asks for some or all of these:
   - a personal statement
   - degree certificates and transcripts with your marks
   - references
   - your English test result
   - certified translations, if your documents are not in English
4. **Accept your offer and pay the deposit.** Pay the **£1,500** deposit. An unconditional offer also triggers the India Merit Scholarship if you qualify.
5. **Check ATAS.** Ask the admissions team if the programme needs an ATAS certificate.
6. **Apply for your visa.** You need your CAS, a current passport, proof of funds and your tuberculosis (TB) test result. India is on the UK's TB test list. The test must be at a clinic approved by the Home Office. Read the [TB test page](https://www.gov.uk/tb-test-visa/countries-where-you-need-a-tb-test-to-enter-the-uk) and the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide).

## After the programme

- **Work in the UK after your course.** The Graduate Route lets you stay and work in the UK after your studies. The visa lasts **2 years** if you apply on or before **31 December 2026**, and **18 months** if you apply on or after **1 January 2027**. A September 2027 student applies in 2028, so expect 18 months. The application fee is **£937**.
- **Jobs.** Recent graduates work as data engineers, data scientists, predictive analysts and software engineers. Recruiters include the European Central Bank, Barclays UK and Morgan Stanley.
- **Start-ups.** Informatics master's alumni founded companies such as FanDuel and Robotical.

## Who it suits

**This programme is a strong choice if:**

- you have a maths, statistics, engineering, physics or CS degree with 60% or more
- you have studied probability and statistics and can code
- you want a highly ranked school and can meet the higher English score

**Think carefully if:**

- your degree had little maths, because the maths rule is strict
- you need a low-cost option, because the first year comes to about **£60,229**
- you need a January start, because the page lists September only

## Sources

faq_json.q: How much does the Edinburgh MSc Data Science cost for Indian students?
faq_json.a: Tuition is £47,680 for 2027/8. With visa living money, the visa fee and the health surcharge, the first year comes to £60,229, or £55,229 with the India Merit Scholarship.

faq_json.q: Can I apply to Edinburgh Data Science without a CS degree?
faq_json.a: Yes, if your 2:1 is in a listed or other quantitative subject and you have introductory programming and about 30 ECTS credits of maths.

faq_json.q: What percentage do Indian students need?
faq_json.a: Edinburgh's India page sets the 2:1 equivalent at 60% or 8.0 CGPA, or 55% or 7.0 if your university is on its Indian Universities List.

faq_json.q: What is the deadline for Edinburgh MSc Data Science 2027?
faq_json.a: Round 1 closes on 31 March and round 2 on 31 May, for September 2027 entry.

faq_json.q: Does Edinburgh need GRE or IELTS for Data Science?
faq_json.a: The programme page does not mention GRE. It asks for IELTS Academic 7.0, with at least 6.5 in three parts and 6.0 in the fourth.
